## Summary
Build the exam blueprint editor UI and API that lets faculty define Bloom level distribution targets, USMLE system proportions, difficulty band allocation, and an equity constraint (>=15% underrepresented clinical scenarios), with full CRUD persistence to Supabase.

## User story
As a faculty member, I want to create an exam blueprint specifying how many questions per Bloom level, USMLE system, and difficulty band, so that my assembled exam is balanced and meets LCME accreditation requirements.

## Why this matters
Without a blueprint, the exam assembly algorithm has no constraints to optimize against, producing random or biased item selections. Blueprints without an equity floor risk exams that exclusively feature majority-demographic clinical scenarios, undermining MSM's mission. Invalid blueprints (proportions not summing to 100%) produce impossible assembly requests.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] POST /api/blueprints creates a new blueprint with validation
- [ ] GET /api/blueprints/[id] returns a single blueprint
- [ ] PUT /api/blueprints/[id] updates an existing blueprint
- [ ] DELETE /api/blueprints/[id] soft-deletes a blueprint
- [ ] Blueprint contains: bloom_distribution (6 levels summing to 100%), system_proportions (18 systems summing to 100%), difficulty_distribution (easy/medium/hard summing to 100%), equity_floor (>= 0.15)
- [ ] Server-side validation rejects: proportions not summing to 100%, equity_floor < 0.15, negative values, no single system > 25%
- [ ] BlueprintEditor UI shows sliders/inputs for each constraint with live validation
- [ ] UI shows warning when coverage heatmap has gaps that conflict with blueprint targets
- [ ] Blueprint is persisted to Supabase with course_id + created_by FK
- [ ] API returns 403 for non-faculty roles

-- Add blueprints table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS blueprints (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  course_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES courses(id),
  institution_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES institutions(id),
  created_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id),
  title TEXT NOT NULL,

  equity_floor NUMERIC(3,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.15 CHECK (equity_floor >= 0.15),

  deleted_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

ALTER TABLE blueprints ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

## API contract
```
POST /api/blueprints
Headers: Authorization: Bearer [token]
Request: {
  course_id: string,
  title: string,
  total_items: number,
  bloom_distribution: Record<string, number>,  // levels 1-6, values sum to 100
  system_proportions: Record<string, number>,   // system codes, values sum to 100
  difficulty_distribution: { easy: number, medium: number, hard: number },  // sum to 100
  equity_floor: number  // >= 0.15
}
Response: { data: { id: string, ...blueprint }, error: null }

GET /api/blueprints/[id]
Headers: Authorization: Bearer [token]
Response: { data: { ...blueprint }, error: null }

PUT /api/blueprints/[id]
Headers: Authorization: Bearer [token]
Request: { ...partial blueprint fields }
Response: { data: { ...updated blueprint }, error: null }

DELETE /api/blueprints/[id]
Headers: Authorization: Bearer [token]
Response: { data: { id: string, deleted_at: string }, error: null }

Errors: { data: null, error: { code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR' | 'FORBIDDEN' | 'NOT_FOUND', message: string } }
```

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// app/api/blueprints/route.ts
import { createServerClient } from '@journey/db/server'
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server'

function validateBlueprint(body: any): { valid: boolean; errors: string[] } {
  const errors: string[] = []
  // Bloom distribution must sum to 100
  const bloomSum = Object.values(body.bloom_distribution as Record<string, number>)
    .reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)
  if (Math.abs(bloomSum - 100) > 0.01) errors.push('Bloom distribution must sum to 100%')
  // No single system > 25%
  for (const [sys, pct] of Object.entries(body.system_proportions as Record<string, number>)) {
    if (pct > 25) errors.push(`System ${sys} exceeds 25% cap`)
  }
  // Equity floor
  if (body.equity_floor < 0.15) errors.push('Equity floor must be >= 15%')
  return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors }
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const supabase = createServerClient()
  const body = await req.json()
  const { valid, errors } = validateBlueprint(body)
  if (!valid) return NextResponse.json({ data: null, error: { code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', message: errors.join('; ') } }, { status: 400 })
  // Insert to Supabase (Rule 6 — Supabase first, no Neo4j needed for blueprints)
  const { data, error } = await supabase.from('blueprints').insert(body).select().single()
  if (error) return NextResponse.json({ data: null, error: { code: 'DB_ERROR', message: error.message } }, { status: 500 })
  return NextResponse.json({ data, error: null })
}
```

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E06/E06-S03.api.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'

const BASE = process.env.BASE_URL ?? 'http://localhost:3000'

const validBlueprint = {
  course_id: process.env.TEST_COURSE_ID,
  title: 'Midterm Exam Blueprint',
  total_items: 50,
  bloom_distribution: { '1': 10, '2': 15, '3': 25, '4': 25, '5': 15, '6': 10 },
  system_proportions: {
    cardiovascular: 12, respiratory: 10, renal: 8, gastrointestinal: 10,
    endocrine: 8, reproductive: 6, musculoskeletal: 6, nervous: 10,
    hematologic: 5, immune: 5, skin: 3, behavioral: 5,
    multisystem: 3, biostatistics: 2, pharmacology: 2, genetics: 2,
    nutrition: 1, aging: 2
  },
  difficulty_distribution: { easy: 30, medium: 50, hard: 20 },
  equity_floor: 0.20
}

test('Acceptance: POST /api/blueprints creates blueprint', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.post(`${BASE}/api/blueprints`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.TEST_FACULTY_TOKEN}` },
    data: validBlueprint
  })
  expect(res.status()).toBe(200)
  const { data } = await res.json()
  expect(data.title).toBe('Midterm Exam Blueprint')
  expect(data.total_items).toBe(50)
  expect(data.equity_floor).toBe(0.20)
})

test('Acceptance: GET /api/blueprints/[id] returns blueprint', async ({ request }) => {
  // Create first
  const createRes = await request.post(`${BASE}/api/blueprints`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.TEST_FACULTY_TOKEN}` },
    data: validBlueprint
  })
  const { data: created } = await createRes.json()

  const res = await request.get(`${BASE}/api/blueprints/${created.id}`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.TEST_FACULTY_TOKEN}` }
  })
  expect(res.status()).toBe(200)
  const { data } = await res.json()
  expect(data.id).toBe(created.id)
})

test('Negative: bloom distribution not summing to 100 rejected', async ({ request }) => {
  const invalid = { ...validBlueprint, bloom_distribution: { '1': 50, '2': 50, '3': 50, '4': 0, '5': 0, '6': 0 } }
  const res = await request.post(`${BASE}/api/blueprints`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.TEST_FACULTY_TOKEN}` },
    data: invalid
  })
  expect(res.status()).toBe(400)
  const { error } = await res.json()
  expect(error.message).toContain('sum to 100')
})

test('Negative: equity floor below 15% rejected', async ({ request }) => {
  const invalid = { ...validBlueprint, equity_floor: 0.05 }
  const res = await request.post(`${BASE}/api/blueprints`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.TEST_FACULTY_TOKEN}` },
    data: invalid
  })
  expect(res.status()).toBe(400)
  const { error } = await res.json()
  expect(error.message).toContain('15%')
})

test('Negative: single system over 25% rejected', async ({ request }) => {
  const invalid = {
    ...validBlueprint,
    system_proportions: { ...validBlueprint.system_proportions, cardiovascular: 30 }
  }
  const res = await request.post(`${BASE}/api/blueprints`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.TEST_FACULTY_TOKEN}` },
    data: invalid
  })
  expect(res.status()).toBe(400)
  const { error } = await res.json()
  expect(error.message).toContain('25%')
})

test('Negative: non-faculty gets 403', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.post(`${BASE}/api/blueprints`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.TEST_STUDENT_TOKEN}` },
    data: validBlueprint
  })
  expect(res.status()).toBe(403)
})
```

## Rollback procedure
If implementation fails mid-way:
1. `DROP TABLE IF EXISTS blueprints CASCADE;` then `pnpm db:types`
2. Remove files: `rm features/coverage-blueprint/components/BlueprintEditor.tsx features/coverage-blueprint/hooks/useBlueprint.ts`
3. Remove API routes: `rm -rf app/api/blueprints/`
4. `git stash && git checkout develop`
